why: The one surface <-> artifact-kind pairing rule (hub `app_opens_kind`, browser `surfaceOpensArtifactKindV1`): a surface app opens a kind it declares itself, or a plugin-level kind whose id the app's own dialect names; never a sibling surface's plugin-level kind, never a kind with another schema.
liveDefect: Ticket 26/09/23 S15, measured inside `s` against hub 7800 on 2026-09-25: the browser admitted on the plugin-level list alone, so a note document (declaration-tree plugin, `manifest.artifactKinds = []`, `apps[0].artifactKinds = [s.note.note / note.document]`) downloaded and hashed its 14.9 MB component and was then refused with `The document component could not be verified`.
